notes.title: Developer Raid Event - SteamLive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680406/4c83477f501367bac2ca8ac5b181d95a7ac57213.png[/img]


[h3]* If there is no event match, the recorded playback is repeatedly sent to Steam Live. [/h3]

[list]
[*] Steam live link: https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199209854204
[*]Official Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/Nfnc5pFWZA
[/list]

[b]If you don't have anyone to play with, join the Discord channel and get people to play with in the "find-playmate" category, or call the developer (@BLENS).[/b]


[olist]
[*] A developer octopus will be waiting for Steam Live on the store page. When you're ready, access the game through the octo code (6 digit code)!
[*] Fight the Developer Octopus! You have to join the Hunter team and hunt the developer octopus that has done a lot of playtesting
[*] Or if you want, you become a VR octopus yourself, and the developer joins the battle as a Hunter team. 
[/olist]
We'll wait until the player gather and when the Hunter team has more than three, we'll start fighting.

Bring your friends or family over and try playing the game before you buy it.
(PC and mobile play are free.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680406/afb822cc27a0cfbea1d7e973955fae9cedb7734a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680406/85a03a408c39fe2f6eab39026761b6694f962f90.png[/img]

[b]If you win, please leave your email address on Steam Live chat or Discord. we'll send you the reward game key.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680406/f864b05ca0528e86b080c792f16920c17b81fab8.png[/img]

notes.title: OctoRaidVR_v1.3.1 BugFix&Patch
notes.content:
OctoRaidVR_v1.3.1 BugFix&Patch

Bug Fix of AI Gift Items
- When Hunter characters use it, there are issues with the use of items and shooting, so code is added to control the phenomenon
- Modifying the code because when the octo character is used, the octo is sometimes aimed at the octo character if there is no Hunter player target

Test the phenomenon control by adding the ability to automatically drop in relation to phenomena that can be thrown through the main map ceiling

Restore password functionality when creating a session

Add invincible status function for 15 seconds when the octo character is first created

Other balance adjustments are carried out

notes.title: OctoRaid VR Now Soft Launch Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680406/0e09dd5ebb8bd5242d7c12549503eff21f19320d.png[/img]

[b]Friend's Pass[/b]
If you buy a [b]$9.99[/b] PC VR main build of the game through the Steam store page, you can enjoy VR play when you wear a VR device and enjoy PC play when you don't have a VR device, so you have ownership of both.

If you want to bring your PC player friends and mobile player friends, there's a free way to access the game!

It's [b]"OctoRaid VR Friend's Pass"[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680406/85a03a408c39fe2f6eab39026761b6694f962f90.png[/img]

Friend's Pass Build for PC, which is listed as a [b]free demo of the Steam page[/b], and Friend's Pass Build for Mobile, which can be downloaded free of charge from the Google Play Store, are invited to a session by a single VR player to enjoy free online play. input the code for the VR player's octo room code on to the game!

[b]VR play of Friend's Pass is only available for tutorial (online session creation is not allowed)[/b]

SideQuest VR and itch.io Paid for [b]$9.99 VR Standalone[/b], you can enjoy VR play on your own with Meta Quest without PC connectivity.

[b]** We have applied for the SideQuest Applab and are currently reviewing it, so if you are selected as an Applab, the build can be converted.[/b]

[b]** We will give you a separate Applab game key to users who bought it on itch.io after switching to Applab.[/b]

Have fun playing and leave good reviews!
